title: the Japanese mythos
audit_comment: THE JAPANESE MYTHOS - the D&DG walk round thirteen, print pp. 81-85. The headline adjudication: the DIGIT-SPLIT calibration - a narrow printed 1 splits into 1 and 7 fragments in the chocr char geometry at 600dpi: the Kishijoten hit points read 31717 and decode as 311, the Kishijoten attack count reads 17 and decodes as 1, the Ebisu hit points read 3173 and decode as 313, and the Hachiman assassin line reads 175th and decodes as 15th. The fraction fingerprint rides again: five X 1/2 foot size cells - Ama-Tsu-Mara 78, Daikoku 66, Ebisu 66, Hachiman 78, Susanowo 78. The EBISU PLANE CATCH: the chocr reads the Seven Heavens where the merged-column voice said Prime Material. The AMATERASU WRAP-LINE CATCH: the printed MU/I 20th level in each wrap line restores the illusionist 20 the merged voice dropped. The Amaterasu Infinite move pins as the -1 sentinel (the R857 Ptah precedent); the Susanowo 12/36/48 triple slash encodes Move 12 MoveAlt 36 with the 48 in the col comment (the klv Ahto precedent); the two hero rows print a bare SIZE: M with no height, pinned as 0 (Yamamoto Date, Yoshi-iye). The MONK/BARD in-each cells are new this round: the Amaterasu 15, Oh-Kuni-Nushi 10 and Yoshi-iye 5 pairs carry the flag. The flagged odd prints pinned as printed: the Hachiman 28/21 and Oh-Kuni-Nushi 15/12 descending move pairs, Tsukiyomi 12/21, and the Raiko 29 and Yoshi-iye 19 moves without a slash.

banner.title: the Japanese mythos - the D&DG walk round thirteen, print pp. 81-85: thirteen beings from Ama-Tsu-Mara the god of blacksmiths to Yoshi-iye the hero whose arrows pierce rocks, the five greater gods (Amaterasu Omikami, Daikoku, Raiden, Susanowo, Tsukiyomi), the three lesser gods (Ama-Tsu-Mara, Ebisu, Kishijoten), the two demigods (Hachiman, Oh-Kuni-Nushi), and the three heroes (Raiko, Yamamoto Date, Yoshi-iye) across seven plane codes.
banner.provenance: primary ink: the extract/ddg tesseract pass (commit cd645b4, pNNN_full.txt + pNNN_tsv.tsv, print = pdf - 1, pages 082-086; the second printing) with the column-split tsv dumps; the collation voice: the archive.org 1st-print derivative (deities-demigods-1st-print) - the chocr char-level word geometry at 600dpi plus the djvu.xml word geometry. The adjudications: the digit-split calibration (the narrow 1 splits: Kishijoten 31717 = 311 hp, 17 = 1 attack; Ebisu 3173 = 313 hp; Hachiman 175th = the 15th assassin), the fraction fingerprint (the five X 1/2 cells: Ama-Tsu-Mara 78, Daikoku 66, Ebisu 66, Hachiman 78, Susanowo 78), the Ebisu Seven Heavens plane catch over the merged-voice Prime Material, the Amaterasu MU/I in-each wrap-line catch, the Amaterasu Infinite move -1 sentinel of the Ptah precedent, the Susanowo 12/36/48 triple slash of the Ahto precedent, and the two bare-M hero size rows pinned 0. Flagged odd prints pinned: Hachiman 28/21, Oh-Kuni-Nushi 15/12, Tsukiyomi 12/21, Raiko 29, Yoshi-iye 19.
